config.map_rule: explicit CLI map only; never inferred from a file name

event_definitions.ddr_ar: PHYSICAL DDR AR. tag=id(bit5:4=port,comp bit2=bank). value=AxLEN. C++:862
event_definitions.ddr_aw: PHYSICAL DDR AW. tag=id. value=AxLEN. C++:863
event_definitions.ddr_r_first: first R beat of an accepted read; value=model latency (NOT RLAST). C++:864-866
event_definitions.ddr_r_last: last R beat; value=model latency. C++:867-869
event_definitions.newcaptured: proxy capture (upstream of DDR). tag=up_id|bank<<4|FASTread<<5. C++:832-838
event_definitions.firstoffer: proxy downstream AR offer (not DDR). tag=down_id(bit2=bank). C++:839-841
event_definitions.arfire: proxy downstream AR handshake at comp slave port (not DDR). C++:842-844
event_definitions.aw_wait_change: ingress AW wait flags changed. tag=bank. C++:822-825

malformed_rows.rule: rows with <5 fields or unparsable integers are DROPPED AND REPORTED (with line numbers), never silently skipped; rows with >5 fields are kept with the extra fields ignored and are reported here too

role_mismatch.rule: port2 (comp) AR must read a src region and a port2 AW must write a dst region; anything else is reported, never re-roled

segments_dropped_empty.rule: a segment with no port2 AR, no port2 AW and no dma_done is empty bookkeeping, not a job; it is dropped and counted here

diagnostics: 76 non-completion access(es) fall inside a V/A data window (reported, not re-roled)
PTW phase still open at window close (start L3138, bank=1); ptwactive at window start is unknown and no end event is invented -- a real bank-1 PTW is still pending at the end of the window

unknowns: Windows are slices of one fixed synthetic run, not the whole run.
A missing ddr_ar/ddr_aw/dma_done line proves nothing about the untraced interval.
PTW activity before the first ptw_start in the window is unknown (level traced on change only).
ddr_r_first/ddr_r_last value is model latency, not RLAST.
fast_response role is not asserted; only its bank/cycle exist.
A source read and a destination write of one A job are never paired (A ring + carry-in).
No PASS is derived from the trace alone.

A ddr_aw bound to a concrete role/PA/job proves that this request's translation had already completed before that AW (the normal TC emits the physical AW only after a successful response.spaddr).  The converse does NOT hold: a missing AW is not proof of an untranslated or uncached request, and the AW cycle is not a precise translation-completion timestamp.

Inside one V job the src-AR vs dst-AW order (earlier/equal/later) is a raw cycle ordering only; it is not evidence that a destination page was cold.  Same-cycle events are never ordered before/after each other (CSV order is preserved as-is).
A row dropped as malformed (see malformed_rows) is reported, never silently ignored; the retained row count is not a completeness proof.
